notes: The UC personal insight questions for transfer applicants, fall 2027 cycle (applications filed in fall 2026), from docs/specs/17-essays.md. Short names and summaries are in Stackd's own words, never UC's text; the app links to UC's page for the exact wording. Transfer applicants answer 4: the one required question plus 3 of the 7 others, up to 350 words each. For each row: open source_url, check the question confirm_on names, fix the summary if it says something the question doesn't, then fill in retrieved_at with the date you checked. The import refuses the file while any retrieved_at is empty or any TODO is left. After the import, the review report's checked_by and checked_at mark rows verified (npm run import:verify); only verified rows reach students. Dry run: npm run import -- data/raw/essays/piq-fall-2027.json --dry-run
